scope: Optional standalone NetworkManager/systemd adapter; no kernel patch or config change.
license: MIT notice from Omarchy PS4 contributors is preserved in the single-file adapter and derived activation tests. Existing kernel and per-file licenses remain unchanged.
adaptations: Moved the optional NetworkManager adapter into linux-psx/contrib at the project owner's explicit request, separate from the distribution-independent kernel contract.
Selected exact release contracts for psX Baikal, original MTS2 and public MTS2; preserved profile UUIDs, lock paths, metadata checks, inherited MAC, first-publication and DMA retention rules.
Added explicit root-owned standalone installation and per-release metadata. Bare --install does not activate or enable startup.
Added explicit --setup to install an exact-release systemd oneshot, enable it at future boots and start it now. No automatic activation retries, unload, reset or rearm.
A repeat invocation only accepts independently verified healthy published state with completed NetworkManager handoff; it does not repeat hardware activation.
Added synthetic release, installation, startup-order and retained-state coverage; no hardware or service operation occurs in host tests.
Included the optional helper and portable setup guide in new CI bundles without adding a NetworkManager/systemd requirement to kernel builds or generic metadata.
hardware_acceptance: EXP-20261017-017 PASS for same-boot service adoption, healthy read-only repeat, independent hash-checked 4MiB wired transfers in each direction and interface-bound verified HTTPS on original 6.18.44-ps4-baikal-mts2. No first activation or fresh unattended boot tested. New psX build and cable recovery remain unqualified; historical EXP016 remains DEGRADED.
